about: Fire Styles Barbershop is a barbershop and coffee bar at 2084 E Edgewood Dr in Lakeland, Florida.
Customers have given it 4.9 stars across more than 1,100 Google reviews, and a Lakeland roundup describes it as a Christ-based barber shop.
Appointments are booked through Booksy, where the King Cuts package comes with free coffee.
